# Location State

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LocationState`](gmeow-LocationState.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LocationState>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The state of a moving entity at a specific point or period in time, including its location, velocity, and pose (position + orientation).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LocationState`](gmeow-LocationState.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the state of a moving entity at an instant or interval — its location, pose, and velocity in an explicit frame.

### Avoid when

- Avoid stating a state without [`gmeow:stateReferenceFrame`](../properties/gmeow-stateReferenceFrame.md) and avoid using it for a static located fact (use [`gmeow:locatedAt`](../properties/gmeow-locatedAt.md)).

### How to use

- Mint [`LocationState`](gmeow-LocationState.md), set [`gmeow:stateOf`](../properties/gmeow-stateOf.md), scope it with [`gmeow:stateAtInstant`](../properties/gmeow-stateAtInstant.md) or [`gmeow:stateDuringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-stateDuringInterval.md), and declare [`gmeow:stateReferenceFrame`](../properties/gmeow-stateReferenceFrame.md); samples compose a [`Trajectory`](gmeow-Trajectory.md) via [`gmeow:hasTrajectorySample`](../properties/gmeow-hasTrajectorySample.md).

### Examples

- ex:s1 a [`gmeow:LocationState`](gmeow-LocationState.md); [`gmeow:stateOf`](../properties/gmeow-stateOf.md) ex:rover; [`gmeow:stateAtInstant`](../properties/gmeow-stateAtInstant.md) ex:t1; [`gmeow:stateReferenceFrame`](../properties/gmeow-stateReferenceFrame.md) ex:siteGrid.
